whyItMatters: an access token passed with --access-token stays in the file, the image layers and the CI logs after the run, so the exposure outlives the moment it was typed.
actions: Rotate the credential at the tool or service.
Replace the literal argument with an environment variable or a protected credential file.
Purge the flag from images, CI logs and shell history.
verification: The old credential no longer authenticates and no invocation carries the literal argument any more.
